MORENEOW-ALWAYS_OFFER_NEW_OPTION.title: Always Offer a New Option
MORENEOW-ALWAYS_OFFER_NEW_OPTION.hover.d: Ensures that at least one Neow option will be a new relic added by this mod.
MORENEOW-ALWAYS_OFFER_DECKBOX.title: Always Offer Unfamiliar Deckbox
MORENEOW-ALWAYS_OFFER_DECKBOX.hover.desc: Ensures that the Unfamiliar Deckbox will always be offered by Neow.
MORENEOW-ONLY_OFFER_NEW_OPTIONS.title: Only Offer New Options
MORENEOW-ONLY_OFFER_NEW_OPTIONS.hover.de: Forces all Neow options to be new relics added by this mod.
